The TAPPaaS console (ADR-034): the site's web UI. The service runs on the mothership (tappaas-console.service, built from tappaas-cicd/ui); this module is its published face — the route through Caddy and the Authentik gate — and, when the AI stack is installed, the assistant's LiteLLM key. It installs nothing of its own.

Installs nothing on any machine; each switch is added with setup-credentials.sh.

Storage for consumer modules (ADR-029): NFS shares declared in config/shares.json through storage-manager, served by the cluster nodes, mounted into consumer guests by storage:nfs. A virtual module, like cluster — nothing of its own to install.
